My dear [Mrs Warburton](/person/1465),
I am sorry to say I have to dine with a great wedding party on Monday at my [brother](/person/1624)’s, as [Miss Walter](/person/616)’s wedding is to be on Tuesday, so that I am obliged to miss the pleasure you kindly propose to me

Yours sincerely

C M Yonge
